blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Flood change detection from bi-temporal multispectral and synthetic aperture radar (SAR) images is essential for rapid disaster response. In this context, Sentinel-2 multispectral imagery provides discriminative spectral observations, whereas Sentinel-1 SAR provides weather-independent structural information. Using these modalities jointly requires modelling temporal evidence while accounting for cross-modal heterogeneity. In particular, change detection is complicated by cloud contamination, illumination variability, acquisition geometry and speckle, and heterogeneous land-cover responses. To address these challenges, we propose SIAMBA, a pseudo-siamese Mamba-based network for bi-temporal flood change detection from paired Sentinel-1 and Sentinel-2 observations. SIAMBA uses dedicated modality-specific encoders with dual-pooling squeeze-and-excitation recalibration and selective state-space processing for long-range spatial context. A gated cross-modal change module derives absolute, signed, and relative log-ratio differences at multiple semantic levels, and attention-refined skip connections support progressive multi-scale decoding. Experiments are carried out on OMBRIA benchmark, which includes an independent test set and geographically diverse subsets in France, Albania, Guyana, and Timor. SIAMBA achieves 81.98% IoU, and 93.57% OA on the independent test set, reaching the highest values in the considered comparison. It also provides the highest unweighted average IoU and OA across four regional subsets spatially disjuncted. These results indicate that combining selective state-space contextual modelling with gated multiscale discrepancy learning effectively improves flood change mapping across the evaluated geographic settings.
blocks.zh: 从双时段多光谱和合成孔径雷达(SAR)图像中发现洪水变化对快速救灾至关重要。 在这方面,Sentinel-2多光谱图象提供不同的光谱观测,而Sentinel-1 SAR则提供天气独立的结构信息. 联合使用这些模式需要模拟时间证据,同时考虑跨模式异质性。 特别是,云层污染、照明变异、获取几何和光谱,以及不同的土地覆盖反应使变化探测变得复杂。 为了应付这些挑战,我们建议SIAMBA,一个伪暹罗曼巴网络,从配对的哨兵1号和哨兵2号观测中进行双时洪灾变化探测. blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Rapid, reliable delineation of flooded areas is important for emergency response, impact assessment, and recovery planning. Satellite observations are especially valuable when direct access to affected areas is limited, but flood change mapping is more demanding than static water segmentation. Flooded regions may appear and recede rapidly, generating elongated or fragmented structures, and interact with vegetation, urban surfaces, terrain, and mixed pixels. Moreover, pixel responses depend not only on inundation but also on acquisition conditions and the surrounding spatial context [ 10 , 6 , 14 ] .
blocks.zh: 迅速、可靠地划定被淹地区对于应急、影响评估和恢复规划十分重要。 当直接进入受影响地区的机会有限时,卫星观测特别有价值,但洪水变化测绘比静水分化要求更高。 被洪水淹没的地区可能出现并迅速消退,产生长长或分化的结构,并会与植被,城市地表,地形,和混合像素等相互作用. 此外,像素反应不仅取决于淹没,还取决于获取条件和周围空间环境[10,6,14].

blocks.en: Multispectral and SAR ( SAR ) observations offer complementary evidence for this task. Multispectral imagery provides detailed spectral information that can distinguish land cover elements such as water, vegetation, bare soil, and built surfaces, but its reliability may be reduced by cloud cover, shadows, atmospheric effects, and changing illumination. SAR operates independently of daylight and penetrates clouds, providing structural and scattering information during adverse weather. However, speckle and variable backscattering from built, vegetated, or rough surfaces can make water-related interpretation ambiguous [ 3 , 1 , 6 ] . Multimodal flood studies consequently seek to exploit the strengths of both modalities through approaches ranging from multi-branch flood detection pipelines to multiresolution sensor fusion [ 10 , 4 ] . Multimodal approaches alone, however, do not guarantee complementary learned features, as the modalities are governed by different imaging physics and may produce incompatible feature statistics. Effective flood change detection must preserve sensor-specific information while identifying temporal and cross-modal evidence relevant to inundation.
blocks.zh: 多光谱和合成孔径雷达观测为这项任务提供了补充证据。 多光谱成像提供了详细的光谱信息,可以区分出土地覆盖元素,如水,植被,裸露的土壤,以及已建成的地表等,但其可靠性可能会被云层覆盖,阴影,大气影响,以及不断变化的发光所降低. 合成孔径雷达独立于日出,并穿透云层,在恶劣天气中提供结构信息和散射信息。 然而,从已建成的、被植被的或粗糙的地表取出光谱和可变回击可能会使与水有关的解释变得模糊 [3, 1, 6]. 因此,多式洪水研究力求通过从多分支洪水探测管道到多分辨率传感器聚变[10,4]等方法来利用这两种模式的优点。 然而,单靠多式方法并不能保证所学到的互补特征,因为模式受不同成像物理的制约,可能产生不相容的特征统计数据。 有效的洪水变化探测必须保留传感器特有的信息,同时查明与淹没有关的时间和跨模式证据。

blocks.en: Existing methods address this requirement at different stages of the processing chain. OmbriaNet, which introduced the OMBRIA dataset adopted in this work, performs supervised flood mapping through a multi-branch convolutional architecture operating on bi-temporal S1 ( S1 ) and S2 ( S2 ) observations [ 3 ] . In heterogeneous change detection, M-UNet establishes cross-sensor comparability through early fusion of concatenated image patches [ 9 ] , whereas other studies retain sensor-specific branches and learn comparable representations using self-supervised clustering, or contrastive objectives [ 11 , 2 ] . Other approaches reduce the modality gap more explicitly. GLCD-DA applies image translation before combining edge-sensitive low-level features with global–local CNN–Transformer representations [ 7 ] , while MMCD uses historical optical observations, temporal memory, and difference enhancement to support change inference when current optical information is unavailable or degraded [ 13 ] . These formulations demonstrate the importance of sensor-adapted processing, multiscale information, and selective fusion. However, they do not jointly combine supervised bi-temporal S1 / S2 flood mapping with efficient long-range contextual modelling and an explicit multilevel representation of cross-modal discrepancies.

blocks.en: Long-range spatial context is particularly relevant because inundated areas may extend over large regions, contain disconnected components, and exhibit irregular boundaries. Convolutional encoders provide strong local feature extraction, but their effective receptive field can be insufficient for relating distant yet spatially connected regions. Global self-attention alleviates this limitation at a computational cost that grows quadratically with the number of spatial tokens. Selective state-space models, including Mamba, instead provide data-dependent long-range propagation with favourable linear sequence scaling [ 5 ] . Their suitability for multimodal interaction has been demonstrated by Sigma in RGB-X semantic segmentation [ 12 ] and by COMO in multimodal object detection [ 8 ] . These methods establish the potential of state-space modelling for multimodal perception, but they do not address bi-temporal flood change detection or explicitly encode the disagreement between sensor-specific change representations.
blocks.zh: 长距离空间背景特别相关,因为淹没地段可能延伸至大面积区域,包含断开的组件,并显示不规则边界。 革命编码器提供了很强的局部地物取出,但其有效的可接受领域可能不足以连接遥远但空间相连的区域。 全球自觉以与空间标志数量相差四倍的计算成本来缓解这一限制. 选择性的状态-空间模型,包括曼巴,提供依赖数据的远距离传播,并带有有利的线性序列缩放[5]. 在RGB-X语义分解[12]和COMO在多式联运对象检测[8]中,Sigma证明了它们适合多式联运相互作用。 这些方法确立了多模式感知的状态-空间建模潜力,但并不涉及双时相洪变化探测,也不明确编码传感器特定变化表示之间的分歧.

blocks.en: To address these limitations, we propose SIAMBA, a pseudo-siamese Mamba-based architecture for supervised flood change detection from paired bi-temporal S1 and S2 observations. SIAMBA integrates sensor-specific temporal encoding with explicit cross-modal discrepancy learning. Pre-event and post-event observations are first grouped within each modality and processed by independent encoders, avoiding shared filters between multispectral reflectance and SAR backscatter. Selective state-space blocks refine the resulting feature hierarchies with long-range spatial context before cross-modal interaction. At corresponding semantic levels, a learned gate modulates absolute, signed, and relative log-ratio discrepancies between the S1 and S2 representations, making complementary and conflicting evidence explicit rather than relying solely on concatenation or implicit attention. The modality-specific and discrepancy features are subsequently combined through attention-refined skip connections and progressive multi-scale decoding to recover both extended inundation patterns and local flood boundaries.
blocks.zh: 为了克服这些局限性,我们提议采用SIAMBA,一种伪暹罗-曼巴建筑,用于从双相相相S1和S2观测中监督洪灾变化探测. SIAMBA将传感器特有的时间编码与明确的跨模式差异学习相融合. 事前和事后观测首先在每种方式中分组,由独立的编码器处理,避免多光谱反射和SAR回放之间的共享过滤. 选择性的状态-空间区块在跨模式互动之前,精炼出具有长距离空间背景的所形成的特征等级. 在相适应的语义层面上,一个被学习到的门会调制出S1和S2表述之间的绝对,签名,和相对的对数-ratio差异,使互补和相冲突的证据明确,而不是仅仅依赖调和或隐含的注意. 模式特有的和相差的特性随后通过注意-精细的跳过连接和渐进的多尺度解码合并,以恢复扩展的淹没模式和局部洪灾边界.

blocks.en: The contributions of this work are as follows: • A pseudo-siamese architecture that encodes bi-temporal S1 and S2 observations in separate sensor-specific branches before multilevel cross-modal interaction. • A gated cross-modal change representation that combines absolute, signed, and relative log-ratio discrepancies using complementary spatial receptive fields. • The integration of selective state-space contextual modelling and attention-refined multi-scale decoding to recover broad-scale inundation patterns, fragmented regions, and local boundaries. • An evaluation on an independent test set and four geographically distinct flood-event subsets, including comparisons with multimodal change-detection methods and unimodal variants.

blocks.en: 2.2 Architecture overview
blocks.zh: 2.2 建筑概况

blocks.en: Figure 1 summarizes the proposed architecture. The network consists of independent S1 and S2 branches, as their inputs represent different physical properties and radiometric distributions. Each branch extracts local spatial features, adaptively recalibrates channel responses, and enriches the representation through spatial state-space processing. Corresponding S1 and S2 features then interact through a gated cross-modal change module at several semantic levels. The deepest modality-specific and change features are aggregated into a fused semantic representation. During decoding, the model combines this context with attention-refined modality-specific and change skip features, progressively reconstructing the spatial resolution required for pixel-level flood change prediction.

blocks.en: The two encoder streams process their respective concatenated temporal observations into compatible, independently learned latent spaces. This pseudo-siamese approach avoids imposing identical filters on multispectral reflectance and SAR backscatter, as their sensing physics and radiometric distributions differ substantially. An initial 7 × 7 7\times 7 convolution is followed by four residual stages with 64, 128, 256, and 512 channels. The residual hierarchy preserves local textures and boundaries at shallow levels while increasing the receptive field and semantic abstraction at deeper levels.

Direct concatenation or summation of SAR and multispectral features can mask whether a local response is complementary evidence, modality-specific noise, or cross-modal disagreement. This representation

Although the encoder weights are modality-specific, the two branches are jointly optimised through the discrepancy paths and the common segmentation loss, encouraging task-oriented co-adaptation between corresponding latent channels rather than assuming comparability at the input level.

blocks.en: 2.5 Multi-scale fusion and decoding
blocks.zh: 2.5 多规模聚变和解码

blocks.en: At the deepest level, the two modality-specific representations and their cross-modal change feature are concatenated, regularized by dropout, and channel-recalibrated to form a fused semantic representation. A decoder with four transposed-convolution stages progressively restores spatial resolution. At each scale, the upsampled feature is combined with the corresponding S1 , S2 , and cross-modal change features. A reduced-resolution self-attention block estimates spatial relationships within the skip representation and restores the attended feature to its original scale through bilinear interpolation. This attention-refined fusion emphasizes informative locations while preserving the detailed features needed to recover flood boundaries, fragmented regions, and small changed areas. A final convolutional prediction head maps the decoder output to a single flood change probability map.
blocks.zh: 在最深层次上,两种模式特有的表述及其跨模式变化特征被调和,被退学所规范化,并被频道再校正,形成一个被熔化的语义表述. 带有四个转录相的解码器逐渐恢复了空间分辨率. 在每个尺度上,上标特征与相应的S1,S2,和跨模式变化特征相结合. 减分辨率自留能块估计跳过表示内空间关系,并通过双线插值使被显示的特性恢复到原来的比例. 这种细心的聚变强调信息化地点,同时保留恢复洪水分界线、零散地段和小变化地段所需的详细特征。 最终的演化预测头图将解码器输出映射到单一的洪水变化概率图上.

blocks.en: 3.1 Dataset and study areas
blocks.zh: 3.1 数据集和研究领域

blocks.en: To assess the performance of the SIAMBA architecture, we use the OMBRIA dataset, a supervised bitemporal and multimodal flood-mapping benchmark dataset based on co-registered S1 SAR and S2 multispectral observations with binary reference maps derived from CEMS ( CEMS ) products [ 3 ] . The dataset contains 3,376 images from 23 flood events acquired between 2017 and 2021. The evaluation includes an independent test set and geographically distinct subsets in France, Albania, Guyana, and Timor. This setup assesses performance across multiple events rather than within a single geographic context.
blocks.zh: 为了评估SIAMBA架构的性能,我们使用OMBRIA数据集,这是一个基于共同注册的S1 SAR和S2多光谱观测的受监督的受控咬字和多模式洪泛绘图基准数据集,其二进制参考地图取自CEMS(CEMS)产品[3]. 该数据集收录了2017年至2021年间获得的23起洪水事件所拍摄的3376幅图像. 评价包括在法国、阿尔巴尼亚、圭亚那和帝汶的独立测试集和地理上不同的子集。 这一设置评估了多个事件的业绩,而不是在一个单一的地域范围内。

blocks.en: 3.2 Data preparation and experimental configuration
blocks.zh: 3.2 国家 数据编制和实验配置

blocks.en: Each sample includes co-registered pre-event and post-event S1 and S2 image patches with a binary flood change annotation. S2 is represented by three RGB channels per date and S1 by one channel (VV) per date, resulting in six S2 and two S1 temporal-input channels. Values are normalized to [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] , and image patches have spatial size 256 × 256 256\times 256 pixels. We followed the official OMBRIA partitioning protocol, using only the provided training set for model training and the predefined test and regional subsets for evaluation. We randomly split the training data into 90 % 90\% training and 10 % 10\% validation partitions using a predefined seed for all comparisons. We applied spatial augmentation to all input observations and their corresponding labels, including horizontal flipping, vertical flipping, and rotations by multiples of 90 90 degrees. To address class imbalance, we used weighted sampling, assigning higher probabilities to patches with larger flood fractions.

blocks.en: 3.3 Comparison methods and evaluation metrics
blocks.zh: 3.3 比较方法和评价衡量标准

blocks.en: To evaluate the performance of SIAMBA, we compare it against six representative flood change-mapping baselines: (i) OmbriaNet [ 3 ] , (ii) Sigma [ 12 ] , (iii) COMO [ 8 ] , (iv) MMCD [ 13 ] , (v) GLCD-DA [ 7 ] , and (vi) M-UNET [ 9 ] . Furthermore, we benchmark the proposed model against its unimodal variants, SIAMBA S1 -only and SIAMBA S2 -only, to assess the impact of multimodal data fusion. All comparison methods were adapted to produce a one-channel binary segmentation output. The same training, validation, augmentation, sampling, and checkpoint-selection protocols were used unless the original method required a task-specific component. Learning rate and weight decay were selected through grid search for all the approaches considered. Positive-class weight has been fixed to w = 1.5 w=1.5 to prioritize flooded samples. The compared methods span bitemporal multimodal flood mapping, Mamba-based multimodal segmentation, cross-modal interaction, memory-based change detection, global-local attention, multi-scale U-Net decoding, and self-supervised multisensor change detection.
blocks.zh: 为了评价SIAMBA的性能,我们将它与六个有代表性的洪水变化绘图基线进行比较:(一) OmbriaNet [3],(二) Sigma [12],(三) COMO [8],(四) MMCD [13],(五) GLCD-DA [7], (六) M-UNET [9]. 此外,我们参照SIAMBA S1和SIAMBA S2的单式变体,将拟议模型作为基准,以评估多式数据聚合的影响。 所有比较方法都经过了调整,以产生一通道二元分解输出. 使用了同样的培训、验证、增强、取样和检查站选取协议,除非最初的方法需要具体任务的组成部分。 学习率和体重衰减是通过对所有考虑的方法进行网格搜索来选择的。 正级重量被固定为w=1.5 w=1.5,以优先处理被淹样本. 比较方法跨越了叮当多模式洪泛绘图、以曼巴为主的多模式分解、跨模式互动、内存变化检测、全球-局部关注、多规模U-Net解码以及自我监督的多传感器变化检测。

blocks.en: Performance is evaluated with IoU ( IoU ) and OA ( OA ). OA summarizes all pixels and can remain high when unchanged pixels dominate the prediction. IoU provides more direct information about the overlap and quality of the flood change region.

blocks.en: 4 Results and Discussion
blocks.zh: 4 结果和讨论

blocks.en: 4.1 Quantitative comparison
blocks.zh: 4.1 数量比较

blocks.en:
Table 2 compares the results obtained by multimodal SIAMBA with those of the seven considered literature methods. On the independent test set, SIAMBA obtains 81.98 % 81.98\% IoU and 93.57 % 93.57\% OA . These values exceed the most accurate competing results by 0.76 0.76 % in IoU relative to M-UNet ( 81.22 % 81.22\% ), and by 0.71 0.71 % in OA relative to OmbriaNet ( 92.86 % 92.86\% ).
Across the regional subsets, SIAMBA obtains the highest IoU in France, Albania, and Timor, and the highest OA in France, Albania, and Guyana. The two exceptions are Guyana IoU , where SIAMBA is second to MMCD by 0.56 0.56 % ( 76.51 % 76.51\% versus 77.07 % 77.07\% ), and Timor OA , where it is second to Sigma by a marginal 0.06 0.06 % ( 95.62 % 95.62\% versus 95.68 % 95.68\% ). SIAMBA therefore ranks first in 6 of the 8 regional dataset–metric combinations. Its regional averages are 75.39 % 75.39\% IoU and 96.22 % 96.22\% OA , compared with the strongest competing averages 71.80 % 71.80\% IoU for M-UNet and 95.09 % 95.09\% OA for Sigma, corresponding to margins of 3.59 3.59 , and 1.13 1.13 %, respectively. This regional pattern suggests a more stable geographic transfer across the evaluated flood events. Across the compared approaches, the results are consistent with the benefit of preserving modality-specific processing before selective interaction, representing discrepancy information explicitly rather than relying only on concatenation or implicit fusion, and combining broad contextual modelling with multiscale boundary recovery.

blocks.en: 4.2 Contribution of multimodal information

Table 3 compares the multimodal model with the S2 -only and S1 -only SIAMBA variants. Multimodal SIAMBA exceeds both unimodal variants for all reported datasets and metric. On the independent test set, the multimodal configuration outperforms S2-only SIAMBA by 8.91 8.91 % in IoU and 4.31 4.31 % in OA , while the corresponding gains over S1 -only SIAMBA are 15.23 15.23 and 8.37 8.37 %.
The regional-average improvements of multimodal SIAMBA are 18.16 18.16 % in IoU and 5.90 5.90 % in OA relative to S2 -only SIAMBA, and 16.21 16.21 and 8.38 8.38 %, respectively, relative to S1 -only SIAMBA. The relative strength of the individual modalities varies across the evaluated settings. S1 -only SIAMBA outperforms S2 -only SIAMBA in France and Guyana, whereas S2 -only SIAMBA is stronger in Albania, Timor, and the independent test set. This pattern is consistent with complementary modality information across the evaluated settings.

blocks.en: Figure 3 compares representative scenes from the independent test set and the France, Albania, Guyana, and Timor subsets. Across these geographically diverse cases, SIAMBA generally produces flood change maps with better spatial agreement with the reference annotations, particularly along irregular boundaries and narrow linear structures. In the test and France examples, SIAMBA preserves internal unchanged regions and field boundaries that are omitted by most competing methods. In Albania, it reconstructs the main flood boundary while suppressing noise patterns observed in some predictions. For the Guyana scene, the proposed method performs well overall, although some small elements seem simplified. In Timor, SIAMBA better retains the irregular upper boundary and limits isolated false detections.
blocks.zh: 图3比较了独立测试集与法国、阿尔巴尼亚、圭亚那和帝汶子集的代表性场景。 在这些地域不同的案例中,SIAMBA制作的洪灾变化图与参考说明有着较好的空间一致,特别是沿着不规则边界和狭窄的线性结构。 在测试和法国的例子中,SIAMBA保留了大多数相竞方法所省略的内部不变区域和场域边界. 在阿尔巴尼亚,它重建了主要的洪水分界线,同时压制在一些预测中观察到的噪音规律. 就圭亚那而言,拟议方法总体上运作良好,尽管一些小要素似乎简化了。 在东帝汶,SIAMBA更好地保留了不规则的上界并限制孤立的假探测.

blocks.en: Overall, the qualitative results are consistent with the quantitative comparison and indicate that the combination of modality-specific features, gated cross-modal discrepancies, and multi-scale decoding supports both large-scale flood delineation and local boundary recovery. The remaining errors are mainly concentrated in small fragmented regions and locally ambiguous transition areas.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,定性结果与定量比较一致,并表明模式特有特征,门式跨模式差异和多尺度解码相结合,既能支持大规模分洪,又能支持局部边界恢复. 所余错误主要集中于支离破碎的小地区和当地模糊不清的过渡地区.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: This paper introduces SIAMBA as a supervised framework for flood change detection from paired bi-temporal S1 SAR and S2 multispectral observations. The proposed architecture preserves sensor-adapted representations through independent encoder branches, refines them with selective state-space contextual modelling, and explicitly describes their relations through gated absolute, signed, and relative log-ratio discrepancies at multiple semantic levels. These features are integrated with attention-refined skip connections to recover both extended inundation patterns and local spatial details. Experimental validation was conducted on the OMBRIA test set. SIAMBA achieved 81.98 % 81.98\% IoU and 93.57 % 93.57\% OA , obtaining the highest values in the considered comparison. It also ranked first in 6 of the 8 regional dataset–-metric combinations and reached regional averages of 75.39 % 75.39\% IoU and 96.22 % 96.22\% OA . Moreover, the multimodal configuration consistently outperformed both unimodal variants, whereas the relative performance of S1 -only and S2 -only SIAMBA varied across regions, indicating that the two modalities provide complementary information. The quantitative and qualitative findings support the effectiveness of the combined sensor-specific, contextual, and discrepancy-based formulation. Future work will extend the proposed formulation to irregular multi-temporal sequences and investigate the integration of complementary contextual information, such as terrain and hydrological priors, to support reliable near-real-time flood monitoring.

SIAMBA取得了81.98%的81.98%的IoU和93.57%的93.57%的OA,在经过深思熟虑的比较中获得了最高值. 它在8个区域数据集中的6个组合中排名第一,达到75.39%的75.39%IoU和96.22%96.22%OA。 此外,多式联运的配置一贯优于单一模式的变体,而S1 -- -- 仅限和S2 -- -- 仅限SIAMBA的相对性因区域而异,表明这两种模式提供了补充信息。 定量和定性结论支持基于传感器的结合、背景和差异的配方的有效性。 今后的工作将扩大拟议配方的范围,使之包括不规则的多时序,并调查地形和水文前兆等补充背景信息的整合情况,以支持可靠的近实时洪灾监测。
